name: writer
description: A casting call: one brief goes to a program, and the program answers with a scene - two characters who were not there before, what they say, how they look, the skin it is drawn in. Its answer is a maxcot score, so the stage plays it: a network wrote a film.

neurons.description: The brief: who walks in, and what they carry. One JSON object, invented for the demo.
Writes the scene from the brief and answers it as a score document (title, bpm, tail, events). No outgoing links, so the run's stdout is the score itself.
